description: “24h” is trending in VN with 2,000+ searches reported by Google. The verified coverage behind the spike, from Báo Dân trí and 2 more.

sections.heading: What is trending: “24h”
paragraphs: “24h” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for VN (snapshot taken 2026-09-21T05:03:40+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 2,000 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from Báo Dân trí, Báo Hà Tĩnh, GenK.vn. The headlines, exactly as published:

“Doanh số Galaxy Z Fold8 tăng 10% sau khi Apple giới thiệu iPhone Duo” — Báo Dân trí

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Sun, 20 Sep 2026 15:40:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-09-21T05:03:40+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-09-21T05:03:46+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.

faq.a: Google's Trending Now feed links the spike to coverage from Báo Dân trí, Báo Hà Tĩnh, GenK.vn. The associated headlines are: “Lo nếp gấp iPhone Duo ngày càng lộ rõ? Đại diện Apple nói: “Hãy cứ kiểm chứng lời chúng tôi”” (GenK.vn); “Doanh số Galaxy Z Fold8 tăng 10% sau khi Apple giới thiệu iPhone Duo” (Báo Dân trí); “Công nghệ nano-texture trên màn hình iPhone Duo: Sự đánh đổi giữa vết gập và độ trong trẻo” (Báo Hà Tĩnh).

This snapshot covers VN. The same term may trend differently in other regions.
